dispute.claim_text: He phoned and literally said 'you go book another car lah'. Then he stayed on the line but did nothing. He never cancelled so I couldn't rebook without paying. If a neighbour hadn't been leaving I'd have missed a court hearing. The app now says the trip was completed as 'no-show'. His screenshot shows 'arrived at pickup'. Arrived where?

counterparty_statement.text: I arrived at the address. The passenger wasn't there. I told her to rebook because I couldn't wait in that rain forever. The app shows I arrived.
